reply_text:
*One ship-blocking finding* in `billing-anniversary` vs `main`:

*HIGH — `src/schedule.js:6–7`: renewal dates clamp against the wrong month.*  
The code uses the source month’s length, then constructs a date in the following month. JavaScript rolls invalid dates forward, causing skipped renewals and anchor drift. Reproduced:
• Jan 31, 2026 → *Mar 3*, instead of Feb 28.
• Jan 31, 2028 → *Mar 2*, instead of Feb 29.
• Feb 28, 2026, anchor 31 → *Mar 28*, instead of Mar 31.

*Recommended fix:* clamp using the *target* month’s length (`daysInMonth(year, month + 1)`), preserving the original anchor. Add regression tests for short-month transitions, leap February, and returning to day 31 afterward.

All 5 existing tests pass, but neither test in `test/schedule.test.js` covers unequal month lengths. No other findings. No files changed.
